comment: Operator overrides for model tiers. "default" applies to every band without its own entry. Each entry may set base_url (OpenAI-compatible chat-completions URL), model (actual slug sent to the endpoint), api_key_env (env var holding the key), price_per_m (USD per million tokens), and send_reasoning (true only for endpoints that accept the OpenRouter reasoning field). Leave base_url empty to keep OpenRouter as the transport. A positive price_per_m also keeps the global spend cap; a zero price is treated as local/free. free_pool is NOT a pin: it is a free-first augmentation layer for the listed bands -- the tier pick underneath stays live, and when every free endpoint is quota-exhausted or failing, the paid pick serves. Each endpoint: name (unique, [a-z0-9._-]), service (key-health group), base_url + model + api_key_env for custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints, openrouter_free=true for a zero-price catalog model picked automatically, extra (body fields merged into every POST, e.g. Gemini's reasoning_effort), rpm/rpd/tpm limits (0 = unlimited), pool_key (endpoints sharing one provider rate pool, e.g. all Groq models share the org-wide RPM bucket, share one pool_key so their RPM windows are counted together; defaults to name).
